module.name: no-unawaited-async-assertion
module.description: Requires direct asynchronous test assertions to be awaited or returned across Jest, Vitest, and Chai-as-promised forms.

scenarios.name: should allow awaited and returned assertions
scenarios.given: a Jest, Vitest, or Chai-as-promised assertion is awaited or returned
scenarios.when: the rule checks expression statements in a test file

scenarios.name: should allow assertions stored for later handling
scenarios.given: an async assertion is assigned to a variable instead of discarded

scenarios.name: should allow Chai completion notification
scenarios.given: a Chai-as-promised assertion ends with notify(done)
scenarios.when: the rule checks the assertion statement
scenarios.then: no violation is reported because completion is passed to the callback

scenarios.name: should ignore synchronous and unsupported assertions
scenarios.given: a synchronous assertion, unrelated expect binding, or non-test file is checked
scenarios.when: the rule resolves the assertion entry point

scenarios.name: should report discarded Jest promise matchers
scenarios.given: a Jest expect resolves or rejects matcher is used as a statement
scenarios.when: the rule traces the assertion chain

scenarios.name: should report Vitest soft polling and browser assertions
scenarios.given: a Vitest soft promise matcher, local test-context expect, expect.poll, or expect.element assertion is discarded
scenarios.when: the rule resolves imports, globals, and computed properties

scenarios.name: should report Chai-as-promised expect and assert forms
scenarios.given: a Chai eventually, rejected, fulfilled, rejectedWith, become, or asynchronous assert result is discarded
scenarios.when: the rule traces imported and namespace assertion chains

scenarios.name: should report void-discarded and parenthesized async assertions
scenarios.given: a void-prefixed or optional assertion call spans comments and computed properties
scenarios.when: the rule unwraps the statement and traces its matcher
